ruleDefinitions.name: Local File Read Using Curl.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "curl.exe" with the "file://" protocol handler in order to read local files.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "curl\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*file\\:\\/\\/\\/.*"))
